# Review of kebra-nagast-ch60b

Units are numbered from 0 (unit 0 = the first sense-unit; this part has no heading unit). All edits were made by script to `units.json` and `gloss.json`; no Geʿez in `t` was touched. Dillmann unavailable; uncertain items are hedged (?). Severity: major = a word dropped or English invented / meaning changed; moderate = `l`/`i`/note/gloss disagreement, wrong parse or label, unsupported reading; minor = polish, hedging, small force loss.

## Pass 1 — units.json

Checks run: every grammatical label against the form; the original word by word into `l`; `l` against `i`; `i` rebuilt from the grammar where it looked remembered; continuity with ch60a and conventions (ጽዮን/Ark feminine, ለ- object marking, እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', ካህናትኒ 'priests too', ተሀየየ 'turn away (?)'). The joined `t` equals the packet Geʿez exactly (3180 characters, 24 units); the single `p` flag (unit 0) matches the packet's single paragraph.

- major: 4, moderate: 14, minor: 26 (44 field edits)
